nodes.label: profile_reactions table
nodes.community_name: DB接続URL判定とリモート運用
nodes.rationale: Unique index leads with profileUserId so per-profile emoji counts are covered by the index; 3-column key prevents duplicate same-emoji reactions.

nodes.label: No denormalized like counter
nodes.community_name: DB接続URL判定とリモート運用
nodes.rationale: Counter would be a drifting cache of the join table, and a falsy-default NOT NULL column makes db:push propose TRUNCATE; lists are <=100 rows so covering-index correlated subqueries are safe and fast.

nodes.label: Per-target like tables (no polymorphic table)
nodes.community_name: DB接続URL判定とリモート運用
nodes.rationale: A polymorphic likes(target_type,target_id) table cannot carry FKs and would repeat the orphan problem of favorites.favoriteSlug; separate tables let libSQL FK cascade delete likes automatically.

nodes.label: Target-first like index column order
nodes.community_name: DB接続URL判定とリモート運用
nodes.rationale: Putting the target column first lets the like-count correlated subquery be satisfied by the index alone (covering); a separate (user_id,target_id) index serves viewer liked-id lookups.
